boundary: Finite-generator quantum Fisher information only; no sensing experiment, noise model, resource-normalized metrological advantage or physical phase standard is claimed.

global_max.proof: For a Hermitian generator with spectrum in [-4,12], max variance=(12-(-4))^2/4=64; equal weight on the extremal eigenspaces attains it.

sector_formula: For probabilities p0,p2,p4 on eigenvalues 12,2,-4, F_Q=4[144p0+4p2+16p4-(12p0+2p2-4p4)^2].
